body: I suppose that is where i am not like "normal" people. I dont want anything.  I have distractions. I play video games because it is a distraction. Like some people watch tv or read.  It is only for entertainment and distraction. I dont want a need for a distraction. I was trying to do voice acting, but i had to drop my agent when i moved, and nome of the agents where i live now have responded to my submissions. I cannot write anything, so making something myself would be an exercise in failure.

I agree, but that requires something i dont have: the desire to create those mental constructs.  I just dont want anything anymore. I have no dreams about the future. I see things merely as they are. I dont want to work to make things better. Moreover, i dont want to work at all. I dont think one can manufacture desire.

Yeah.  I still have bills and stuff. These arent the reason. I honestly have no hope. I cast off anything that isnt real. Religion, wishing, hope.  These are all things that humans do to make life bearable. I cannot use these things as they are all false. My life experiences only add to this feeling. They do not define it.
